The '''Vassek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Vassek system was located deep within Confederate space. The planet [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek's]] [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] served as the secret location for the [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] of the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==History==
[[File:Vassek.png|thumb|left|180px|Grievous approaching Vassek's third moon in his personal fighter]]

Following his escape from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody, [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was believed to have fled to the Vassek system. However, it was merely a ruse, orchestrated by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to lure [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into a trap within [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] castle in order to test the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General's]] effectiveness in eliminating Jedi. [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] was the only survivor of the [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|event]], fleeing the system in his [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]].<ref name="LOG" />
